chart.title: Gender of the head of state
chart.subtitle: The head of state is the chief public representative of their country.
chart.note: This is recorded on December 31 of each year.

Woman head of state (31st December).descriptionShort: Denotes whether the head of state in office on December 31 is a woman.
Woman head of state (31st December).descriptionProcessing:
Equivalent to V-Dem's `v2exfemhos` indicator, but it is modified to reflect the gender of the head of state by the end of the year, December 31. V-Dem, instead, seems to refer to other points during the year.

Affected by change are:

- Ali Ben Bongo Ondimba:
  - 2009-2022 Gabon
- Chulalongkorn (Rama V):
  - 1873-1909 Kingdom of Siam	(Thailand)
- Dieudonné François Joseph Marie Reste:
  - 1923-1925 Tchad [part of French Equatorial Africa]
  - 1929-1930 French Dahomey [colony within French West Africa]
  - 1932-1934 Ivory Coast [part of French West Africa]
  - 1936-1938 Middle Congo as part of the French Equatorial Africa
- Letsie III:
  - 1990-1994, 1996-2024 Lesotho
- Miguel I "o Rei Absoluto":
  - 1828-1833 Portugal
- Moshoeshoe II:
  - 1960-1965 British Protectorate of Basutoland (Lesotho)
  - 1966-1989, 1995 Lesotho
- Prince Zaifeng:
  - 1908-1911 China
- Rajkeswur Purryag:
  - 2012-2014 Mauritius
- Shimon Peres:
  - 2007-2013 Israel

### Data imputation
Unlike most indicators in this dataset, this one is not extended back in time with the data of the historical entity a country was part of. Who led a country is a fact about that country rather than about the power that ruled its territory earlier, so the years before a country appears in V-Dem's data are left empty.
